scope: Closed set of selected source passages and explicitly enumerated spelling profiles. The audit is a decision for every candidate family, not an exhaustive collation of every surviving manuscript.
date_rule: Earliest actual witness or securely dated tradition <=1440; late-only and unresolved candidates excluded.

sources.citation: David Pingree (ed.), Picatrix: The Latin Version of the Ghayat al-Hakim (Warburg Institute, 1986)
sources.date_evidence: PDF pp51–53, printed li–liii, Excerpt VI: Ambrosiana M.28.sup., copied in the fourteenth century, ff92–92v; complete I.4 mansion sequence.
sources.scope: I.4 main edited text and separately printed Excerpt VI only. Separate microfiche apparatus not acquired; no exhaustive manuscript-variant claim.

sources.citation: Jean-Patrice Boudet, Magie théurgique, angélologie et vision béatifique dans le Liber sacratus sive juratus attribué à Honorius de Thèbes, MEFR Moyen Âge 114.2 (2002), 851–890
sources.date_evidence: pp851–852 and critical-edition heading p871: A=Sloane3854, mid14c; B=Sloane313, second half14c; C=Sloane3885, mid16c.
sources.scope: §10 seven seal angels and related Michael/Mychael reference §10; §17–23 planetary angel catalogue; §25 invocation; all name variants in the printed apparatus of those passages. Other spirit/demon catalogues outside selected list passages are not silently imported.

sources.citation: Vatican, Reg.lat.1300 f45v, digitized manuscript; Peterson, Heptameron comparative table2, Raziel column, a transcription linked to this exact folio
sources.date_evidence: Grévin and Véronèse 2004 p331 n84 (reporting Boudet2001 n38): second half14c, correcting an older date around1500.
sources.scope: Seven planetary names only. Fixed editorial transcription uses Saquiel. The handwritten second name is not independently resolved letter by letter here; no new palaeographic spelling is invented.

profiles.order: printed order; cyclic rotations/directions are C3 search operations, not source variants
profiles.date_basis: securely pre1440 tradition; not every edited spelling individually dated
